title: Min Jeong
text: I am a PhD student in Geospatial Information Science at the University of Texas at Dallas.

title: Research
text:
• Jeong, M., & Chun, Y., Evaluating Predictive Accuracy for Spatial Interaction in Origin-Destination Flows


The analysis uses commuting flow data from the Longitudinal Employer-Household Dynamics Origin-Destination Employment Statistics (LODES) for eleven counties in the Dallas-Fort Worth (DFW) metropolitan region. Block-level flows were aggregated to 1,704 census tracts, resulting in 164,507 origin-destination flow observations. Each observation represents the number of workers traveling between an origin and a destination tract. These flows are shaped by origin and destination characteristics, geographic separation, and surrounding spatial structure. Accordingly, this study evaluates whether incorporating spatial features for both origins and destinations improves predictive performance across different modeling frameworks.
